_meta.description: 3D model registry for diorama rendering. Lookup order: species → genus → life_form fallback.
notes: Species entries override genus entries override life_form defaults
life_form codes follow DSE EVC benchmark standard (IT, T, MS, SS, PS, LH, MH, SH, LTG, LNG, MTG, MNG, GF, SC, BL)
Each entry has 'folder' and 'default' — path is folder/default
Species entries may have 'variants' with named files and optional height_range
Add new species/genus entries as bespoke models are built — no code changes needed

Eucalyptus camaldulensis.notes: River Red Gum — character species for plains grassy woodlands (VVP + GipP)

Eucalyptus tereticornis.notes: Gippsland Red-gum — shares model with River Red Gum for now, similar form

Themeda triandra.notes: Kangaroo Grass — dominant tussock across all grassland/woodland EVCs

Allocasuarina.notes: Sheoak — drooping needle-like branchlets. Covers verticillata, littoralis, luehmannii

Banksia.notes: Banksia — serrated leaves, distinctive flower spikes. Covers integrifolia, marginata

Melaleuca.notes: Paperbark/Tea-tree — defines swamp scrub and riparian. Covers ericifolia, squarrosa

Leptospermum.notes: Tea-tree — dense shrub form, small leaves. Covers laevigatum, continentale, lanigerum

Austrostipa.notes: Spear Grass — tussock-forming native grass. Covers bigeniculata, mollis, rudis, scabra

Eucalyptus.notes: Generic eucalypt — fallback for species without bespoke models

PS.notes: Prostrate Shrub — shares model with SS
